[b]TL;DR: Spellsworn is a hidden gem. If you get a kick out of watching your friends burn to death in a pool of lava, or if you're a fan of the twitchyness of mobas but not the farming and item management - this game is for you.[/b]

[b]The good:[/b] [i]Gameplay is disgustingly addictive. Spells are unique and gameplay changes as strategies evolve and spell combos are discovered, countered, and re-invented. The aesthetic and feel of the game is cute too. Devs are responsive, respond to feedback, bug reports, and put out regular updates. Spells recently recieved a complete overhaul as just one example of their continued dedication to the project, and although the game is still in early alpha it's very competent at what it does. The Devs have big plans for additional content and functionality for the game, but it already looks promising.[/i]

[b]The bad:[/b] [i]Game population is very low at time of writing, due to being an indie title in early access, without much in the way of exposure. You wont find a game through matchmaking with that being the case, so if you're looking to fling spells at strangers, you're S.O.L. 
However, if you've got 2 or 3 friends to play with, you'll still have a blast. If you don't you'll have to be satisfied blowing up bots for now.[/i]

这绝对是我在steam上最喜欢的游戏，没有之一！

    这是一款MOBA类游戏，如果你喜欢DotA2或者LOL或者虚荣（Vainglory），你一定会爱上这款小游戏。
    
    更好的是，Spellsworn更加轻量级：
       
         移除了补兵和装备的设定（这很屁股）
         没有平A设定，角色的攻击方式只依赖于玩家在开局前用有限的金币购买的技能（这一点很像兽人必须死这类塔防游戏）
          
    同时具有玩法多样性和平衡性：
         技能分为远程、近战、防御、位移、控制、AOE六类，玩家最多可拥有8个技能槽，每个技能最多升3级。另外竞技场地很    小，场内经常有突发事件，加上如此多的技能所以战斗会比较激烈。

    所有技能都是非指向性的，所以很常见的场景是：
         吃我一记火球！
         我躲！
         Ciao！CD怎么还没好?!
         吃我一记冰弹！（被敌方冰弹击退到炎浆里...）

    在LOL里空了技能会有小学生骂你，然而在这里，没有关系，用你风骚的走位苟到CD结束再喂对面一波技能吧！这是一个单纯的享受战斗快感的小游戏，没有段位，没有氪金，只是单纯地去战斗就好。

    缺点是，目前线上没人，因为玩家基数小。所以只能约战或者和基友本地联机撕逼。好消息是开发者在5月更新的时候说正在加入人机模式，这样至少还能虐虐电脑。不过如果你有1到7个好基友的话，强烈推荐一人一份！

    虽然人少，但是从好评和我的体验来说，这款游戏绝对是杰作。只差一个著名游戏主播在大家面前玩一玩就能火了。所以我给了开发者以下留言：
You guys do awesome jobs! Although there are no other players to play with, I will not refund it to show my support and respect for you! I hope you hold on this great work and wait to see the game regarded as a masterpiece by all players!

Spellsworn sometimes feels like the bastard child of Smash Bros and the MOBA genre. You and a number of other players fight in an ever-shrinking arena, trying to push each other into the surrounding lava. You control a single character (Your spellsworn) much like a MOBA, and use various spells to knock your opponents around. Spells range from the basic Fireball to the Chakram (A spinning disc that can orbit you to protect you from other spells and damage opponents) and Counter Pulse (Instantly reflects anything within a short distance, perfect for countering opponents attacks). 

Hilarities ensue, as the game can both lead to absurd situations like getting thrown out by gimmicky, but highly powerful combos, or getting caught up between 5 people slinging fireballs at each other. You can also end up with highly skill-intensive 1v1's where every pixel of movement and second of cooldown matters, as the arena grows too small for comfort. 

The game currently (June 2016) suffers from a small population, meaning there won't always be people to play with, but there are Steam groups for that, and the devs regularly host playdates.

Overall a great game with some of the most fun gameplay I've ever had, that is only getting better. See you in the ring!

Setup kurduktan sonra READY tuşuna basarak oyuna geçiyoruz. Amacımız kapışma alanı bitene kadar hayatta kalmak veya rakiplerimizi öldürmek. Oyun bunun çok kolay olmaması için tasarlanmış ve temel anlamda oldukça başarılı buldum. Mesele sadece Mouse ile aim alırken Magicka usulü QWERASDF tuşlarıyla büyü yollamak değil; çünkü rakibiniz Blink olabilir, siz büyünüzü gönderemeden kancayla sizi çekip lavların arasına götürebilir.

[b]Artılar: [/b]
+ Competitive yapısı iyi ve gelişmeye devam etmekte
+ Skill çeşitliliği ve upgrade olayı mücadelenin daha beklenmedik ve karmaşık olmasını sağlıyor
+ Oyuncunun yeteneğine bağlı

- Grafikler biraz fazla renkli gibi ama Orcs Must Die!, Torchlight veya Magicka oynadıysanız o kadar da gözünüze batmayacak
- AI/Bot match seçeneği ve tutorial yok, ama bunun öneminden yapımcılara bahsettim, dikkate alacaklarını söylediler

After 30 mintues of playing Spellsworn, I knew I had to write a quick review:

           Spellsworn is based off of a very popular WarCraft III mod 
Combat takes place on an ever-shrinking circular stone field (other map's im sure will come, but i don't feel they are neccessary this early in development) that is surrounded by lava. Being in lava is similiar to standing underneath a turret on LoL or Dota. This is the main source of damage output, being able to knock your enemies into the lava. It isn't an instant kill, but it rapidly drains health, because of this, most of the spells are focused around knockbacks (quantified in game as punches i think). Others allow you to teleport, heal, reflect enemy spells, and so on(loads more spells on the way). The player starts with 100 health and is out of the match at 0, the winner being the last one standing. Most spells do some damage, but it is usually minimal. 
       The idea is to soften everyone up, so when the battleshield shrinks down to a heartpoundingly small size and lava is everywhere you lookandohmygodlookoutforthatmagicmissleowowowowDEAD. It is tons of fun. Its like if the towers on LoL or DOTA were invincible and slowly crept towards eachother on either side. Think of how intense that would be, thats Spellsworn.
    
Obligatory 10/10 would burn again
